d: Short jet black hair exists only in a small braided ponytail on the back of the head and as a groomed goatee, paired with sharp, narrow amber eyes and a smug expression. The face appears in its mid-thirties with a muscular, heavyweight build and broad shoulders. The outfit consists of an olive green sleeveless shirt under a black tactical chest rig, brown cargo pants, and black combat boots, all accented by a brown utility belt with multiple pouches and a thigh-mounted grey pouch. A large black rifle is slung across the back.
